fit.sheet: Mitsubishi M5218AL/P/FP data sheet (data book pages 2-467 to 2-471, with the 8P2S-A outline of March 1998), at ±15 V; phase margin assumed (D-169)
fit.figure: Electrical characteristics at ±15 V: GVO 110 dB typ (86 min, RL ≥ 2 kΩ), fT 7 MHz, SR 3.0 V/µs (GV = 0 dB, RL = 2 kΩ), ICC 3.0 mA (both amplifiers), VOM ±14 V typ at RL ≥ 10 kΩ and ±13 V at RL ≥ 2 kΩ, VCM ±14 V typ. The voltage gain vs frequency figure falls at 20 dB a decade to 0 dB near 7 MHz. No phase margin
fit.method: A small macromodel (scripts/fit_models.py opamp_card, D-162): a tanh transconductance stage limited to 10 µA into C1 sets the slew rate, gm the unity-gain crossing and R1 the open-loop gain; a second pole gives the phase margin; diode clamps and an output resistance set the swing; the supply current is drawn from the rails. The sheet names the M5218AL (SIL-8, outline 8P5) with the P and FP. Gain bandwidth 7 MHz and slew rate 3.0 V/µs as the table gives them (Mitsubishi's 1984 data book gave 2.2 V/µs for the M5218L), phase margin 60° assumed (D-169). The output clamps 0.8 V from each rail behind 180 Ω, so it swings to 1.05 V of the rails into 10 kΩ and 1.97 V into 2 kΩ (the table's ±14 V and ±13 V typ).
fit.note: Input bias, offset, noise, common-mode limits and the output's current limit are not modelled: the input stage is ideal (1 TΩ).
